summary: On July 28, 2026, the Board of Directors of Republic Services, Inc. approved an increase in the regular quarterly dividend from $0.625 to $0.67 per share, a 4.5-cent raise, payable October 15, 2026, to shareholders of record October 2, 2026. This routine capital-return action was disclosed in an Item 8.01 8-K and does not constitute a special-situation event such as an activist campaign, strategic review, or tender offer. The filing includes only the dividend declaration and standard cover-page data; no other strategic or structural matters are noted. Monitoring future dividend policy or capital allocation is the only observation.
